pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:100 the heal cap is looked up by row id in session memory while every retry mints a new row (src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:944) whose persisted attempt is never checked, so auto-heal retries each child failure afresh and the lineage has no bound

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:963 writes attempt+1 into the new row but nothing reads it as a budget, and the parent stays failed (no supersession), so tasksPage(['failed']) behind Retry failed and Heal all re-retries already-retried parents and forks the lineage

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:45 classifies by regex over error + description + title, so the task's own instruction text ('fix the failing test') picks the class; the unknown fallback at :49 is honest and not auto-retried

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:61 the over-cap stop is a toast and no exhausted state is written to the row; the lineage itself is retry-only (src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:952 is the sole parent_task_id writer)

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/RunDeskControls.tsx:143 bulk retry re-queues every failed row regardless of class or attempt, and auto-heal (SelfHealingPanel.tsx:136) has no cross-item cap when one environmental cause fails the whole queue

src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:39 the time-healing class (timeout) is excluded from auto-heal; the auto-fixable classes are healed by a new agent run, not by waiting, so there is no delay ladder to tune

pairs.registryProposal: Two findings. (1) error-classification-for-retry warns against message matching but not against matching the WORK's own text: here the regex reads the task title and description, so an instruction that mentions a failure decides the retry class. Proposed rule: classify from the failure evidence, never from the input that produced it. (2) Missing pairing: src-tauri/src/engine/healing_retry.rs (delayed/chained retry plus a persona failure-count circuit breaker) is this repo's strongest retry-backoff surface and belongs to no context in context-map.json, so the subject reaches only this UI context.
